item.text: The revised structure keeps four interceptions, uses spaced opening positions, and preserves both medics during the artillery burst. Midnight returns as a blocker and third artillery attacker, freeing a caster slot without another medic absence. The plan will explicitly test whether his handoff preserves interception and whether the three attackers damage the artillery through competing targets.
